entities.name: Mouse SOX-19 (Q62249)
observations: The 55-aa query exactly matches reviewed Mus musculus SOX-19 (UniProt Q62249); annotated localization is nucleus.
Pfam detects an HMG_box domain (PF00505) across residues 1–55, consistent with a DNA-binding HMG-box protein.
Sequence-derived properties: 55 aa, predicted mass 6.86 kDa, theoretical pI 9.99; these do not establish biochemical activity.
